scale.basis: dimensioned views: front, section A-A, top, side, details C and D

frame: origin at the centre of the open bottom face, Z up along the housing axis, side pipes along ±X, front pad facing -Y
body: axisymmetric shell revolved from one annular wall profile: bottom spigot lip Ø195 (z 0-5), drum Ø200 (z 5-88), inner cavity Ø190 open at the bottom (the Ø190 bore under the top hole is this cavity), shoulder to a frustum Ø185 -> Ø171 (z 92-130, 20° included), top plate 3 thick
central inlet tube Ø66 OD / Ø60 bore hanging 25 down from the top (z 105-130), part of the same revolved profile
two side pipes Ø60 OD / Ø50 bore on the X axis at z 45, reaching x = ±120, both open into the cavity, so together they read as one Ø50 bore along X
four lugs beside the pipes at y = ±45, z 45, with their faces at x = ±100
front mounting pad 80 wide x 36 high, face at y = -105, z 22-58, trimmed at r 96 inside the wall

features.source: Ø60.00 section A-A; opens into the Ø190 cavity
M6(6X), 70.00/100.00 in the front view, detail C

guessed: The wall thickness is taken as 2.5-5 mm, from Ø190/Ø195/Ø200.
The shoulder is simplified to a straight chamfer from z 88 to z 92, with the frustum diameters taken from the 20° taper.
The lug and pad sizes are estimated from details C and D.
The tap depths are guessed at 10 mm (the M6 tap drill is Ø5).
